The following events took place in '''29 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Raith Sienar/Legends|Raith Sienar]] develops plans for his [[Expeditionary Battle Planetoid]], which will evolve into the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="RP" />
*[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] takes part in a [[Wicko District Garbage Pit|garbage pit]] [[Pit racing|race]] and is attacked by a [[Ke Daiv|Blood Carver]].<ref name="RP" />
*[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and Anakin Skywalker take the ''[[Star Sea Flower]]'' to [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]] to get information on mysterious organic ships rumored to be produced and some of the fastest ships in the galaxy as well as to find [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Vergere]]. [[Seed-partner]]s later build a ship for them which Anakin calls the ''[[Jabitha]]''. Anakin defeats Ke Daiv during an [[Second Battle of Zonama Sekot|attack]] by [[Raith Sienar/Legends|Sienar]] and [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Tarkin's]] [[Outland Regions Security Force/Legends|fleet]]. Obi-Wan and Anakin head to [[Seline]].<ref name="RP" />
*''Jabitha'' quietly dies on the cold planet of Seline.<ref name="RP" />
*[[Thracia Cho Leem]] leaves the Jedi Order.<ref name="RP" />
*Obi-Wan Kenobi constructs his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's second lightsaber/Legends|second]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="Followers">''[[Jedi Apprentice Special Edition: The Followers]]''</ref>
*Obi-Wan Kenobi visits [[Didi Oddo]] and his daughter [[Astri Oddo|Astri]] in their [[Dex's Diner/Legends|cafe]] and informs them about [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn's]] death. {{Circa}}<ref name="Path to Truth">''[[Jedi Quest: Path to Truth]]''</ref>
*The [[Republic Group/Legends|Republic Group]] purchases the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Stellar Envoy'']].<ref name="Millennium Falcon">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>
*[[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] begins her second term as [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace">{{Film|I}}</ref>
*Preparations begin for the [[Outbound Flight Project]].<ref name="Outbound Flight">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>
*The [[Jamaane coup]] occurs.<ref name="Essential">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>
*[[Dal Perhi]] becomes [[Underlord|Leader]] of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]].<ref name="Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter">''[[Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter]]''</ref>
*The last fatality-free professional [[Podracing/Legends|Podrace]] before [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Hnn-Podracing Faces Uncertain Future">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|sports/13328_1.html|Podracing Faces Uncertain Future}}</ref>
*[[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] becomes [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]].
*[[Grievous/Legends|Qymaen jai Sheelal]] is transformed into a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Eyes of Revolution date">Chapter 19 of ''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]'' states that transformation of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] took place "a decade earlier" than [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] per ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', which would place this story around 29 BBY.</ref>
